name: Business Strategy
description: Competitive dynamics, sustainable moats, market positioning, and capital allocation.

dimensions.name: Competitive Moats & Defensibility
dimensions.description: Network effects, switching costs, scale economies, brand, and proprietary technology.

rubricCriteria.90-100: Identifies true structural defensibility; anticipates incumbent response.
rubricCriteria.70-89: Identifies defensibility factors with minor vulnerability to substitutes.
rubricCriteria.50-69: Confuses operational excellence or first-mover speed with a permanent moat.
rubricCriteria.0-49: Zero defensibility; commodity business model easily cloned.

dimensions.name: Strategic Trade-offs & Focus
dimensions.description: Defining what NOT to do; maintaining focus despite tempting distractions.

rubricCriteria.90-100: Articulates explicit sacrifices required to win target market segment.
rubricCriteria.70-89: Solid prioritization with slight reluctance to kill low-ROI ideas.
rubricCriteria.50-69: Tries to be everything to everyone; dilutes resources.
rubricCriteria.0-49: Chases every shiny opportunity; lacks strategic direction.
